title.zh: 消除组句重复词块歧义

purpose.en: Close the Japanese Writing defect found in the four-language matrix: a sentence with two identical particles left the already selected copy in the choice bank, making the second copy ambiguous and preventing the final slot from being filled.
purpose.zh: 修复四语矩阵发现的日语写作缺陷：句子含两个相同助词时，已选副本仍留在候选区，导致第二个副本有歧义、最后一个空位无法填满。

en: Remove each selected token from the available choice bank while keeping its unique identity in the answer slots.
Return a token to the choice bank when the learner removes it from an answer slot.
Allow repeated words and particles to be selected independently and still trigger automatic grading when all slots are filled.
zh: 词块选入句子后从候选区移除，同时在答案空位中保持唯一身份。
学习者从答案空位撤回词块时，该词块重新出现在候选区。
重复单词或助词可独立选择，并在填满所有空位后正常触发自动判题。

en: Sentence-builder interaction in subscribed courses and shared Sprint surfaces; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, or database schema behavior.
zh: 订阅课程及共享 Sprint 界面的组句交互；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点或数据库结构。

en: Filter selected token identities out of the visible choice bank instead of leaving disabled duplicates.
Keep slot removal reversible so every selected token can return to the bank.
Add a regression contract for duplicate-label selection and removal.
zh: 按唯一身份从可见候选区过滤已选词块，不再保留禁用的同名副本。
保留空位撤回能力，使任何已选词块都能回到候选区。
增加重复标签选择及撤回的回归合同。

en: Run the duplicate-token regression contract, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then use the ordinary test learner to complete the same 16-token Japanese Writing sentence with two identical particles and verify feedback plus counter advance.
zh: 执行重复词块回归合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare，再由普通测试学员完成含两个相同助词的同一道 16 词块日语写作题，并验证反馈与题号推进。

en: The remaining en/ja/es/it course matrix and observable normal-versus-slow audio timing require the fresh Terra production retest after this deployment.
zh: 剩余英/日/西/意真实学习矩阵及可观察的正常/慢速音频时长，需要在本次发布后由 Terra 重新执行生产验收。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
